name: inkwell
description: A simple local-first Markdown editor with no telemetry.

scripts.macos:entitlements: npm run macos:build:sandbox && bash scripts/check-macos-entitlements.sh build/macos-local/Inkwell.app
scripts.test: echo "Public test files are not packaged; run npm run check for public verification."
scripts.check: python3 -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('app/inkwell.py', cfile='/tmp/inkwell.pyc', doraise=True)" && npm run security:source && npm run flatpak:posture
